articles.headline: FIFA exec resigns, second exec says Infantino deceived staff over plan
articles.description: Two senior FIFA officials criticized Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off plan Friday with one resigning as a presidential adviser and a second saying staff were deceived by project that must not go ahead.

articles.headline: Infantino's World Cup battle risks undermining years of progress in women's soccer
articles.description: As FIFA doubles down on its controversial World Cup plans and countries threaten to boycott, the 2027 Women's World Cup could be the first major tournament affected. That's a problem for women's soccer.

articles.headline: Ivory Coast part ways with AFCON-winning coach Emerse Faé
articles.description: The Ivorian Football Federation have confirmed that Emerse Faé will leave his position as head coach upon the expiry of his contract on July 31, bringing to an end his remarkable two-and-a-half-year spell.

articles.headline: U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham becomes first leader of a major country to call on FIFA president Gianni Infantino to resign
articles.description: The U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham has called on FIFA President Gianni Infantino to resign over the plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to a private equity group.
